definition_zh: 亲爱的；昂贵的；亲爱的（称呼）；哦，天哪
definition_en: loved or much liked; costing a lot of money; a name for someone you love
core_image: 从心里捧出来的一个温柔称呼
scene: 生日那天，奶奶递给我一张亲手写的贺卡。My grandmother started the card with the word Dear, which made me smile.
sceneCN: 这里 dear 是「亲爱的」（第 1 个义项：被心捧着的人）；句意是奶奶在贺卡开头写了 Dear，让我笑了。

collocations.zh: 亲爱的李小姐（书信称呼）

derivatives.zh: 由 dear 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「深切地；昂贵地」
由 dear 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「亲爱；贵重」
由 en-（使）加 dear 构成，义为「使受喜爱」
由 dear 的旧形加 -ling 构成，义为「心爱的人」

senses.title: Loved or much liked
senses.definition: loved by someone or very much liked
senses.definitionCN: 被某人爱着或非常讨人喜欢
senses.example: My dear friend helped me carry the heavy books home.
senses.exampleCN: 我亲爱的朋友帮我把沉重的书搬回家。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the heart's attachment, because a person held close in feeling receives this warm label.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最古老的意义是心的依恋：一个人被感情紧紧捧着，便得到这个温柔的称呼。

senses.title: Costing a lot of money
senses.definition: costing a lot of money
senses.definitionCN: 价钱很高
senses.example: In that shop everything is too dear for students.
senses.exampleCN: 那家店里的东西对学生来说都太贵了。
senses.why: What you treasure is precious, and precious things cost much, so the feeling of treasuring stretched to price.
senses.whyCN: 被珍爱的东西显得贵重，贵重的东西价格高，「珍视」的心情便延伸出「昂贵」的价钱义。

senses.title: A name for someone you love
senses.definition: a word used when talking to someone you love
senses.definitionCN: 对所爱之人的称呼用语
senses.example: Come here, dear, and have some soup.
senses.exampleCN: 过来吧，亲爱的，喝点汤。
senses.why: People speak the feeling out loud, so the adjective turned into a calling word for loved ones.
senses.whyCN: 把心里的爱说出口，形容词便变成呼唤亲人的名词性称呼，这是感情直接长出的用法。

senses.title: A cry of surprise
senses.definition: an exclamation showing surprise or worry
senses.definitionCN: 表示惊讶或担忧的感叹语
senses.example: Oh dear, I left my homework at home!
senses.exampleCN: 哦，天哪，我把作业忘在家里了！
senses.why: A worried cry borrows a soft word, because small troubles call for gentle surprise.
senses.whyCN: 遇到小麻烦的惊呼借用了这个温柔的词，因为轻微的慌张适合用亲昵的语气来表达。

intro.en: Dear traces back to an Old English word for something precious.
intro.cn: dear 可追溯到古英语中表示「珍贵的」的一个词。

items.en: The word deore meant precious, valuable or beloved.
items.cn: 古英语 deore 意为珍贵的、有价值的、被爱的。

items.en: It belongs to a Germanic family of words about value and love.
items.cn: 它属于日耳曼语族中关于价值与爱的词族。

items.en: The spelling became dere and then dear, and the beloved sense stayed strong.
items.cn: 中古英语拼写经历 dere 再到 dear，「所爱」的义项一直稳固。

items.en: Writers also used it for things that cost much, since beloved things feel precious.
items.cn: 作家也用它指花钱多的东西，因为被珍爱之物显得贵重。

items.en: It settled into letters and greetings as a polite opening word, and British English keeps the old price sense.
items.cn: 它固定为书信礼貌的开头称呼；英式英语仍保留旧的价钱义。

note.en: These words belong to the affection family or share the gentle sound of dear.
note.cn: 这些词属于亲爱词族，或与 dear 有相似的温柔读音。

normalIntro.cn: 用「心捧」的画面和 dear 词族来锁定这个词。

normal.cn: dear to me 表示在心里被捧得很近。

normal.cn: Dear 是许多书信的第一个词。

normal.cn: deer 与 dear 同音，但它是有四条腿的鹿。

normal.en: dearly is the adverb: love someone dearly.
normal.cn: 副词是 dearly：love someone dearly（深爱某人）。

normal.en: For price, expensive is the safer word today.
normal.cn: 表示价钱如今用 expensive 更稳妥。

abstract.cn: 想象一颗被双手捧着的心。

abstract.en: Hear the soft tone people use when calling a loved one.
abstract.cn: 听一听人们呼唤所爱之人时的温柔语气。

abstract.en: Feel the small shock of a tiny mistake, oh dear.
abstract.cn: 体会出了小差错时轻轻一声 oh dear 的心情。

examples.en: She wrote Dear Grandma at the top of the letter.
examples.cn: 她在信的开头写了 Dear Grandma（亲爱的奶奶）。

examples.en: This bag is too dear for me; let's find a cheaper one.
examples.cn: 这个包对我来说太贵了，我们找个便宜点的吧。

examples.en: Oh dear, the school bus is leaving without me.
examples.cn: 哦，天哪，校车要开走了，落下我了。

definition_en: the end of the life of a person or living thing
core_image: 生命之灯缓缓熄灭的那一刻
scene: 科学课上我们观察了一颗种子如何结束休眠。The death of the old tree left a sunny space for young plants.
sceneCN: 这里 death 是「消亡」（第 2 个义项：事物的终结）；句意是老树的枯亡给幼苗留出了阳光。

senses.title: The end of life
senses.definition: the moment or state when a person or animal stops living
senses.definitionCN: 人或动物停止生命的时刻或状态
senses.example: The death of the class hamster made everyone sad.
senses.exampleCN: 仓鼠的死让全班同学都很难过。
senses.why: Life is a flame; when the flame goes out, the ending needs a word of its own.
senses.whyCN: 生命像一盏灯，灯火熄灭的时刻需要一个专属的名字，于是有了 death 这个词。

senses.title: The end or ruin of something
senses.definition: the end of an activity, idea or custom
senses.definitionCN: 某种活动、观念或习俗的结束
senses.example: The death of that old tradition took many years.
senses.exampleCN: 那个旧传统的消亡花了许多年。
senses.why: When a thing stops forever, we speak of it like a life ending.
senses.whyCN: 一件事彻底停止时，我们像谈论生命结束一样谈论它，死亡义便借给了终结。

senses.title: Great degree, in phrases
senses.definition: used in phrases to show the strongest degree
senses.definitionCN: 在短语中表示最高程度
senses.example: The funny film made us laugh to death.
senses.exampleCN: 那部搞笑电影让我们笑死了。
senses.why: A feeling so strong it fills the whole body borrows the image of a total ending.
senses.whyCN: 强烈到极致的感觉借用了「彻底终结」的画面，仿佛情绪满到把人整个填满。

intro.en: Death grew from an old Germanic word for dying.
intro.cn: death 由一个表示「死去」的古老日耳曼词生长而来。

items.en: The word death meant dying or the end of life.
items.cn: 古英语 death 意为死去或生命的终结。

items.en: It shares a root with words for dying across Germanic languages.
items.cn: 它与日耳曼语族中各语言表示「死」的词共享词根。

items.en: The spelling became deth and then death in the thirteenth century.
items.cn: 十三世纪拼写从 deth 变为 death。

items.en: Writers used it not only for people but for the end of kingdoms and customs.
items.cn: 作家不仅用它指人的死亡，也指王国与习俗的终结。

items.en: Fixed phrases like laugh to death and death rate keep it busy today.
items.cn: 现代英语中 laugh to death、death rate 等固定短语仍在频繁使用。

note.en: These words stand around death, from its verb to its near neighbours.
note.cn: 这些词围绕 death，从它的同族动词到近邻概念。

normalIntro.cn: 用「灯灭」的画面和 die 词族记住 death。

normal.en: die is the verb, death is the noun.
normal.cn: die 是动词，death 是名词。

normal.en: dead is the adjective: the tree is dead.
normal.cn: 形容词是 dead：the tree is dead（树死了）。

normal.en: deadly means able to kill.
normal.cn: deadly 表示能致命的。

normal.en: th at the end: death, teeth, breath.
normal.cn: 词尾是 th：death、teeth、breath。

normal.en: laugh to death is a friendly exaggeration.
normal.cn: laugh to death 是友好的夸张说法。

abstract.en: See a candle's flame shrink to one point and go dark.
abstract.cn: 想象烛火缩成一点然后暗下去。

abstract.en: Hear the long h at the end of death, like a soft breath.
abstract.cn: 听 death 结尾长长的 h，像一声轻轻的呼气。

abstract.en: Feel how a custom fades slowly, like a light going out.
abstract.cn: 体会习俗慢慢淡去的感觉，如同灯一点点熄灭。

examples.en: The death of the goldfish taught us to say goodbye.
examples.cn: 金鱼的死教会了我们如何道别。

examples.en: The old bridge's death came when the river changed course.
examples.cn: 河流改道后，那座老桥的使命终结了。

examples.en: My grandpa's stories nearly made us laugh to death.
examples.cn: 爷爷的故事差点把我们笑死。

sensesIntro.en: Death names life's ending, then lends that ending to customs and strong feelings.
sensesIntro.cn: death 先指生命的终结，再把这个终结借给习俗的消亡和极致的情绪。

definition_zh: 决定；下决心；裁决；决定（结果）
definition_en: to choose what to do after thinking about it
core_image: 在心里把天平拨向一边的那只手
scene: 放学后大家讨论去哪里打球，最终有了主意。We finally decide to play basketball in the park near school.
sceneCN: 这里 decide 是「决定」（第 1 个义项：思考后选定做法）；句意是我们最终决定在学校附近的公园打篮球。

collocations.phrase: make up your mind and decide

derivatives.zh: 由 decide 变词尾加 -sion 构成，义为「决定」
由 decide 的过去分词转成形容词，义为「明确的；坚决的」

senses.title: To choose after thinking
senses.definition: to choose one thing to do after thinking about the choices
senses.definitionCN: 思考各种选择后选定要做的事
senses.example: I decide to join the reading club this term.
senses.exampleCN: 这学期我决定加入读书社。
senses.why: The mind weighs choices like a scale, then tips to one side.
senses.whyCN: 心里像天平一样称量各个选项，最后拨向一边，选定即决定。

senses.title: To settle a question officially
senses.definition: to settle a question or contest by an official judgement
senses.definitionCN: 通过正式判断解决争议或比赛结果
senses.example: The referee decides who wins the race.
senses.exampleCN: 裁判决定谁赢得赛跑。
senses.why: When two sides disagree, a judge's mind tips the scale for everyone.
senses.whyCN: 双方争执不下时，由裁判心中的天平替所有人拨向一边，于是有了裁决义。

senses.title: To strongly affect a result
senses.definition: to strongly control what the result will be
senses.definitionCN: 强烈左右结果
senses.example: One goal decided the whole match.
senses.exampleCN: 一个进球决定了整场比赛。
senses.why: The hand that tips the scale controls the outcome, so key moments were said to decide.
senses.whyCN: 拨动天平的手掌控结果，于是关键时刻被称为决定性时刻，这是从意象自然延伸的用法。

intro.en: Decide comes from a Latin word for cutting off other choices.
intro.cn: decide 来自拉丁语中表示「切断其他选项」的词。

items.en: Decidere meant to cut off, formed from de- (off) plus caedere (to cut).
items.cn: 拉丁语 decidere 意为切断，由 de-（离开）加 caedere（切）构成。

items.en: In Roman courts decidere meant to settle a dispute by cutting away doubt.
items.cn: 在罗马法庭上 decidere 表示斩除疑虑、裁定争议。

items.en: Old French carried decider into learned writing.
items.cn: 古法语把 decider 带进书面语。

items.en: English took decide in the fourteenth century, first in law and argument.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪吸收 decide，最初用于法律和论辩。

items.en: Daily life widened it to every small choice, from lunch to teams.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到日常大小选择，从午饭到组队都用。

note.en: These words share the Latin root caedere or describe making choices.
note.cn: 这些词与拉丁词根 caedere 同源，或同样描述做选择。

abstract.cn: 想象剪刀把除了一条路之外的所有路都剪断。

abstract.en: Hear a judge's gavel cut the noise in half.
abstract.cn: 听法槌一响，把嘈杂声一切两半。

examples.en: We decide to give our old toys to the children in the village.
examples.cn: 我们决定把旧玩具送给村里的孩子们。

examples.en: The captain decides when the team should rest.

examples.en: One piece of bread decided the picnic: it was the last food left.
examples.cn: 最后一块面包成了野餐的关键：那是仅剩的食物。

senses.title: A choice made after thinking
senses.definition: the choice you make after thinking about it
senses.definitionCN: 思考之后做出的选择
senses.example: Choosing my science project topic was a hard decision.
senses.exampleCN: 选科学课的研究题目是个艰难的决定。
senses.why: When the mind's scale settles, the settled side gets a name.

senses.title: An official judgement

senses.definitionCN: 由裁判、法庭等做出的正式判断

senses.why: The court's scale settles not only one mind but the whole room.
senses.whyCN: 法庭或裁判的天平替全场人拨定方向，于是决定义延伸到正式裁决。

normal.en: make a decision is the common phrase.
normal.cn: 常用短语是 make a decision（做决定）。

normal.en: indecision means no decision, just hesitating.
normal.cn: indecision 表示没有决定、只是犹豫。

normal.en: -sion words end with a zh or sh sound.
normal.cn: -sion 结尾的词发 /ʒ/ 或 /ʃ/ 音。

normal.en: a final decision ends all the talk.
normal.cn: a final decision（最终决定）终结所有讨论。

abstract.en: Picture a scale finally resting on one side.
abstract.cn: 想象天平终于停稳在一侧。

abstract.en: Hear the class cheering when the vote is announced.
abstract.cn: 听全班在表决结果宣布时的欢呼。

abstract.en: Feel your shoulders relax once the choice is made.
abstract.cn: 体会选定之后肩膀放松下来的感觉。

examples.en: After long talk, our decision was to plant trees by the river.
examples.cn: 长谈之后，我们决定在河边种树。

examples.en: The coach's decision to change players saved the game.
examples.cn: 教练换人的决定挽救了这场比赛。

examples.en: Writing down my decision helped me stop hesitating.
examples.cn: 把决定写下来帮我停止了犹豫。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「低遂心」——低声说「遂了心愿」，做出「决定」

root: 来自拉丁语 decisio（切下、了结），是 decidere（切掉多余选项）的名词形式；进入英语后泛指一切思考后的决定。

sensesIntro.en: Decision names the settled end of thinking, then official rulings.
sensesIntro.cn: decision 指思考停稳后的结果，再延伸到正式裁决。

core.cn: 核心意象：停稳的天平

intro.cn: decision 保留拉丁「切」词根并加名词后缀。

latinIntro.cn: 词根 cid/cis 来自 caedere（切）。

definition_en: to make something look more beautiful by adding things to it
core_image: 给房间挂上彩带和星星的人
scene: 新年快到了，教室里大家忙着布置。We decorate the classroom with paper lanterns and red banners.
sceneCN: 这里 decorate 是「装饰」（第 1 个义项：加东西让更好看）；句意是我们用纸灯笼和红色条幅装饰教室。

derivatives.zh: 由 decorate 变词尾加 -ion 构成，义为「装饰；装饰品」
由 decorate 加 -ive 构成，义为「装饰性的」
由 decorate 加 -or 构成，义为「装饰者；室内装修师」

senses.title: To add beautiful things
senses.definition: to add pretty things to make a place or object more beautiful
senses.definitionCN: 添加漂亮的东西使场所或物品更美观
senses.example: We decorate our desks with paper flowers on Teachers' Day.
senses.exampleCN: 教师节我们用纸花装饰课桌。
senses.why: A plain thing invites little touches of colour and shine.
senses.whyCN: 平淡的东西呼唤色彩与亮光的点缀，添上它们便是装饰。

senses.title: To paint and fix a house
senses.definition: to paint the inside of a room or repair it to look nice
senses.definitionCN: 粉刷房间内部或修整使其好看
senses.example: Dad wants to decorate the kitchen this weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 爸爸想这个周末把厨房装修一下。
senses.why: A bigger project is decoration for a whole room.
senses.whyCN: 从贴几张贴纸到粉刷整间屋子，是同一个「变好看」愿望的放大版。

senses.title: To give an honour
senses.definition: to give someone a medal as an honour
senses.definitionCN: 授予某人奖章以示嘉奖
senses.example: The brave firefighter was decorated by the city.
senses.exampleCN: 那位勇敢的消防员受到市政府嘉奖。
senses.why: A medal is a decoration you can wear, so honouring used the same word.
senses.whyCN: 奖章本身就是可佩戴的装饰物，给英雄佩戴勋章便借用了装饰的词。

intro.en: Decorate comes from a Latin word for making something fit and fine.
intro.cn: decorate 来自拉丁语中表示「使合宜而漂亮」的词。

items.en: Decus meant honour or beauty; decorare meant to adorn and grace.
items.cn: 拉丁语 decus 意为荣誉、美好；decorare 意为妆点、使优美。

items.en: Decorum, proper behaviour, grew from the same family of looking right.
items.cn: 表示体面的 decorum 也出自同一「得体好看」词族。

items.en: The word reached English through Latin learning in the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 该词约于十五世纪经拉丁学识传入英语。

items.en: It came to mean adding beauty to rooms, cakes and trees.
items.cn: 现代英语中它指为房间、蛋糕、树木增添美感。

items.en: Military medals gave it the honour sense still used today.
items.cn: 军功章赋予它沿用至今的授勋义。

note.en: These words share the Latin root dec- or describe making things beautiful.
note.cn: 这些词与拉丁词根 dec- 同源，或同样描述让事物变美。

normalIntro.en: Use the ribbon image and the dec- family to remember decorate.
normalIntro.cn: 用「彩带」的画面和 dec- 词族记住 decorate。

normal.en: decor- means beauty and honour in Latin.
normal.cn: 拉丁语中 decor- 表示美好与荣誉。

normal.en: decoration is the thing, decorate is the action.
normal.cn: decoration 是装饰品，decorate 是动作。

normal.en: decorum and decent keep the proper-beauty sense.
normal.cn: decorum、decent 保留了「得体美好」义。

normal.en: decorate something with something is the pattern.
normal.cn: 句型：decorate something with something（用…装饰…）。

normal.en: The ending -ate marks an action verb.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ate 表动作，如 decorate。

abstract.en: Picture fairy lights climbing a window frame.
abstract.cn: 想象彩灯爬上窗框。

abstract.en: Hear the tape rip as banners go up.
abstract.cn: 听条幅挂起时胶带撕开的声音。

abstract.en: Feel the pride of a medal pinned on a chest.
abstract.cn: 体会勋章别在胸前的那份自豪。

examples.en: We decorate the hall with our own paper cuttings for the show.
examples.cn: 演出前我们用自己的剪纸装饰大厅。

examples.en: Mum taught me to decorate cakes with strawberries.
examples.cn: 妈妈教我用草莓装饰蛋糕。

examples.en: The old soldier keeps his decorated hat on the shelf.
examples.cn: 老兵把获过勋章的帽子摆在架子上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戴扣来」——戴胸章、挂彩扣，都来「装饰」

root: 来自拉丁语 decorare（妆点），词根 dec- 表示「美好、合宜、荣誉」；同族词 decent（体面）、decorum（礼仪）。

sensesIntro.en: Decorate spreads from adding beauty to fixing rooms and giving honours.
sensesIntro.cn: decorate 从增添美感，扩展到装修房屋和授予荣誉。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hanging beauty on plain things
core.cn: 核心意象：把美挂在平常之物上

intro.en: Decorate is built on the Latin root for beauty and honour.
intro.cn: decorate 建立在表示美好与荣誉的拉丁词根上。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root dec- means fit, beautiful, honoured.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 dec- 意为合宜、美好、荣耀。

definition_zh: 深的；深沉的；深厚的；深刻的
definition_en: going far down from the top; very strong or serious
core_image: 从表面一直往下走不到底的距离
scene: 游泳馆里，教练告诉我们浅水区和深水区的分界线。The pool has a deep end for good swimmers only.
sceneCN: 这里 deep 是「深的」（第 1 个义项：向下延伸很远）；句意是泳池只有游得好的同学才能去深水区。

derivatives.zh: 由 deep 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「深深地」
由 deep 的旧形加名词后缀 -th 构成，义为「深度」
由 deep 加动词后缀 -en 构成，义为「加深」

senses.title: Going far down from the top
senses.definition: going or reaching far down from the surface
senses.definitionCN: 从表面向下延伸很远
senses.example: The well is so deep that our voices echo back.
senses.exampleCN: 这口井很深，我们的声音会传回回声。
senses.why: Measuring downward distance gave the word its first picture: far from surface to bottom.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早的画面就是向下的距离：从表面到底部很远，便有了「深」。

senses.title: Very strong or serious
senses.definition: very strong, serious or hard to change
senses.definitionCN: 非常强烈、认真或难以改变
senses.example: She has a deep love for old songs.
senses.exampleCN: 她对老歌有深厚的热爱。
senses.why: Feelings buried far inside are hard to reach, so strong emotion borrowed the distance image.
senses.whyCN: 藏在心底很深的感情难以触碰，强烈的情感便借用了「远距」的画面。

senses.title: Hard to understand
senses.definition: difficult to understand or full of meaning
senses.definitionCN: 难以理解或意味深长
senses.example: Grandpa's short sayings are often deep.
senses.exampleCN: 爷爷的短句常常意味深长。
senses.why: Meaning hidden below the surface takes effort to dig out.
senses.whyCN: 藏在表面之下的含义需要挖掘，于是「深」也指道理深奥。

intro.en: Deep goes back to Old English words for far down.
intro.cn: deep 可追溯到古英语中表示「往下很远」的词。

items.en: The word deop meant far down, extending far below the surface.
items.cn: 古英语 deop 意为往下的很远、低于表面很多。

items.en: It belongs to a Germanic family of depth words.
items.cn: 它属于日耳曼语族的深度词族。

items.en: The spelling settled as deep, and the noun depth grew from the old form deop with -th.
items.cn: 拼写定型为 deep，名词 depth 由旧形 deop 加 -th 构成。

items.en: Writers used it of feelings and thought, not only of water and holes.
items.cn: 作家开始用它形容感情与思绪，不再只指水和洞穴。

items.en: Modern English keeps all senses: deep water, deep sleep, deep thought.
items.cn: 现代英语保留各义项：deep water、deep sleep、deep thought。

note.en: These words share the deep family or describe far-down distance.
note.cn: 这些词属于 deep 词族，或同样描述向下的距离。

entries.definitionCN: 认为（拼写相近，词源无关）

normalIntro.en: Use the well image and the deep family to remember the word.
normalIntro.cn: 用「深井」的画面和 deep 词族记住这个词。

normal.en: deep describes distance downward.
normal.cn: deep 描述向下的距离。

normal.en: depth is the noun: the depth of a pool.
normal.cn: 名词是 depth：the depth of a pool（泳池深度）。

normal.en: deepen the river means make it deeper.
normal.cn: deepen the river 表示把河道加深。

normal.en: two e in the middle: d-e-e-p.
normal.cn: 中间有两个 e：d-e-e-p。

normal.en: take a deep breath before you speak.
normal.cn: 开口前先 take a deep breath（深呼吸）。

abstract.en: Picture a well with no visible bottom.
abstract.cn: 想象一口看不见底的水井。

abstract.en: Feel a friendship that grows year after year.
abstract.cn: 体会一年一年生长的友谊。

abstract.en: Hear a sentence that keeps giving meaning each time you read it.
abstract.cn: 听一句每读一次都有新含义的话。

examples.en: The river near our school is too deep for swimming.
examples.cn: 我们学校附近的河太深，不能下去游泳。

examples.en: I took a deep breath before going on stage.
examples.cn: 上台前我深吸了一口气。

examples.en: This book is deep, so I read it slowly.
examples.cn: 这本书很深奥，所以我读得很慢。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「地铺」——地铺要睡得香，得「深」度睡眠

root: 来自古英语 deop（往下很远），属日耳曼语族的深度词族；名词 depth 由旧形加名词后缀 -th 构成。

sensesIntro.en: Deep measures downward distance, then dives into feelings and meaning.
sensesIntro.cn: deep 先丈量向下的距离，再潜入感情与含义的深处。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: distance from surface to bottom
core.cn: 核心意象：从表面到深处的距离

intro.en: Deep is a short root with a small family of depth words.
intro.cn: deep 是个短词根，带着一小圈深度词族。

latinIntro.en: Deep is Germanic, so it has no Latin relatives here.
latinIntro.cn: deep 属日耳曼语源，这里没有拉丁同族词。

definition_en: a unit for measuring temperature or angles; the level or amount of something; a university qualification
core_image: 刻度盘上一个个相等的小台阶
scene: 天气预报说今天很热。The temperature reached thirty degrees, so we stayed indoors.
sceneCN: 这里 degree 是「度数」（第 1 个义项：温度计量单位）；句意是气温高达三十度，我们只好待在室内。

derivatives.zh: 由 de-（向下）加 grade（级）构成，义为「降级；使变差」
由拉丁词根 grad（步、级）构成，义为「逐渐的」
由词根 grad 加 -ate 构成，义为「毕业；取得学位」

senses.title: A measuring unit
senses.definition: a unit for measuring temperature or angles
senses.definitionCN: 计量温度或角度的单位
senses.example: Water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius.
senses.exampleCN: 水在一百摄氏度沸腾。
senses.why: A scale cuts a whole into equal steps, and each step is one degree.
senses.whyCN: 刻度把整体切成相等的小台阶，每一个台阶就是一度。

senses.title: The level or amount of something
senses.definition: the level, amount or extent of something
senses.definitionCN: 某事物的等级、数量或程度
senses.example: I agree with you to some degree.
senses.exampleCN: 我在某种程度上同意你的看法。
senses.why: Steps on a scale became a way to say how much of something there is.
senses.whyCN: 刻度上的台阶被借来说明事物有多少、到什么地步，于是有了程度义。

senses.title: A university qualification
senses.definition: a qualification given by a university after finishing study
senses.definitionCN: 完成大学学业后获得的资格证明
senses.example: My cousin got her degree last summer.
senses.exampleCN: 我表姐去年夏天拿到了学位。
senses.why: Learning was once climbed step by step, and each finished stage became a degree.
senses.whyCN: 学业被看作一级一级的台阶，走完一段便授予一「度」，即学位。

intro.en: Degree grew from Latin and French words for a step.
intro.cn: degree 由拉丁语和法语中表示「台阶」的词生长而来。

items.en: Gradus meant a step or stair, the root of grad- words.
items.cn: 拉丁语 gradus 意为台阶、阶梯，是 grad- 词根的来源。

items.en: Old French degre meant a step or rank.
items.cn: 古法语 degre 意为台阶或等级。

items.en: English took degree in the thirteenth century for ranks and steps.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪吸收 degree，用于等级与阶梯。

items.en: Science fixed it as a unit for heat and angles.
items.cn: 科学界把它定为温度和角度的单位。

items.en: Universities kept the old sense of a finished step for their qualifications.
items.cn: 大学保留了「走完一级」的旧义，用于授予学位。

note.en: These words share the step root or describe levels and units.
note.cn: 这些词与「台阶」词根同源，或同样描述等级与单位。

normalIntro.cn: 用「梯子」的画面和 grad- 词族记住 degree。

normal.en: to some degree means partly.

normal.en: an angle of sixty degrees is a sharp corner.

abstract.en: Picture a thermometer climbing step by step.
abstract.cn: 想象温度计一格一格地升高。

abstract.en: Feel yourself climbing a staircase one step at a time.
abstract.cn: 体会自己一级一级爬楼梯。

abstract.en: Hear the announcer read each graduate's name, step by step.
abstract.cn: 听主持人逐个念出毕业生名字，一级接一级。

examples.en: The temperature dropped below zero degrees last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚气温降到零度以下。

examples.en: Our teacher said hard work raises your ability by degrees.
examples.cn: 老师说努力会让能力渐渐提升。

examples.en: I agree with the plan to some degree, but not fully.
examples.cn: 我在一定程度上同意这个计划，但不完全同意。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 grad-/gred- 意为台阶、行走。

definition_en: tasting or smelling very good; giving great pleasure
core_image: 一口咬下去让人眯起眼睛的香味
scene: 午餐时间，食堂飘出红烧肉的香味。The noodles Mum cooked are so delicious that I ask for another bowl.
sceneCN: 这里 delicious 是「美味的」（第 1 个义项：味道非常好）；句意是妈妈煮的面太好吃，我还要再添一碗。

derivatives.zh: 由 delicious 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「美味地」
由 delicious 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「美味」
同词源家族词，义为「高兴；乐趣」

senses.title: Tasting or smelling very good
senses.definition: having a very pleasant taste or smell
senses.definitionCN: 味道或气味非常好
senses.example: The strawberry cake smells delicious.
senses.exampleCN: 草莓蛋糕闻起来很香。
senses.why: Good food pulls a happy face out of you, so taste pleasure got a word of its own.
senses.whyCN: 好吃的食物让人不由自主露出笑容，味觉的愉悦便拥有了自己的词。

senses.title: Giving great pleasure
senses.definition: giving great pleasure to the mind or senses
senses.definitionCN: 给心灵或感官带来极大愉悦
senses.example: We spent a delicious afternoon in the library.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在图书馆度过了一个惬意的下午。
senses.why: The joy of taste widened to any joy that feels like a treat.
senses.whyCN: 味觉的快乐扩展到一切像享受一样的快乐，于是有了怡人义。

intro.en: Delicious comes from Latin words for delighting.
intro.cn: delicious 来自拉丁语中表示「使人愉悦」的词。

items.en: Delicia meant delight or pleasure; delicere meant to allure.
items.cn: 拉丁语 delicia 意为愉悦；delicere 意为吸引。

items.en: Old French carried delicios into writing.
items.cn: 古法语把 delicios 带进书面语。

items.en: English took delicious in the fourteenth century, first for any delight.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪吸收 delicious，最初泛指各种愉悦。

items.en: Taste became its main home because food delight is the most common.
items.cn: 由于食物带来的愉悦最常见，味觉成了它主要的用武之地。

items.en: It now describes food above all, with a light figurative use for pleasant times.
items.cn: 如今它主要形容食物，也可轻描淡写地形容惬意的时光。

note.en: These words share the delight root or describe great taste.
note.cn: 这些词与愉悦词根同源，或同样形容极好的味道。

entries.definition: fine and easily broken, same family
a fine food or the quality of being delicate

entries.definitionCN: 乏味的（拼写相近，词源无关）
宗教的（拼写相近，词源无关）

normalIntro.en: Use the aroma image and the delight family to remember delicious.
normalIntro.cn: 用「香气」的画面和愉悦词族记住 delicious。

normal.en: delicious contains delight: it delights your tongue.
normal.cn: delicious 里含 delight：它让舌头愉悦。

normal.en: -cious is an adjective ending.
normal.cn: -cious 是形容词后缀。

definition_en: a doctor who takes care of people's teeth
core_image: 举着小镜子和探针查看牙齿的白衣人
scene: 校医说我有一颗牙要检查。The dentist showed me how to brush the teeth at the back properly.
sceneCN: 这里 dentist 是「牙医」（第 1 个义项：护理牙齿的医生）；句意是牙医教我正确刷后面的大牙。

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁词根 dent（牙）加形容词后缀 -al 构成，义为「牙齿的」
由 dentist 加名词后缀 -ry 构成，义为「牙科学」
由 tri-（三）加 dent 构成，义为「三叉戟」

senses.title: A doctor for teeth
senses.definition: a person trained to look after and treat teeth
senses.definitionCN: 受过训练、检查和治疗牙齿的人
senses.example: The dentist says I should floss every night.
senses.exampleCN: 牙医说我应该每晚用牙线。
senses.why: Latin dens means tooth, and -ist names the person of a trade, so the tooth person is a dentist.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 dens 意为「牙」，后缀 -ist 表示从业者，掌管牙齿的人便是牙医。

senses.title: The clinic or practice place
senses.definition: the place or business where a dentist works, used informally
senses.definitionCN: 牙医工作的地方，口语中代指诊所
senses.example: Mum is at the dentist this afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 妈妈今天下午在牙科诊所。
senses.why: People often name the worker to mean the workplace, like saying school for a lesson.
senses.whyCN: 人们习惯用从业者的名字代指其工作场所，就像用 school 代指上课一样。

intro.en: Dentist comes from Latin dens, a tooth.
intro.cn: dentist 来自拉丁语 dens（牙齿）。

items.en: Dens meant tooth; the related form dentis gave the stem dent-.
items.cn: 拉丁语 dens 意为牙，相关形式 dentis 给出词干 dent-。

items.en: French formed dentiste from dent plus the trade ending -iste.
items.cn: 法语由 dent 加职业后缀 -iste 构成 dentiste。

items.en: Before dentist, English used the phrase tooth-drawer for such workers.
items.cn: 在 dentist 出现前，英语用 tooth-drawer（拔牙人）称呼这类从业者。

items.en: The word dentist was borrowed in the eighteenth century as a learned form.
items.cn: dentist 一词于十八世纪作为学术化借词进入英语。

items.en: Dentistry, dental and denture grew from the same stem.
items.cn: dentistry、dental、denture 都由同一词干派生。

note.en: These words share the Latin tooth root or name medical workers.
note.cn: 这些词与拉丁「牙」词根同源，或同样称呼医务工作者。

abstract.en: Feel the proud smile after a clean check-up.

examples.en: I was a little nervous before seeing the dentist, but it did not hurt.
examples.cn: 看牙医前我有点紧张，但其实并不疼。

examples.en: The dentist gave me a sticker after fixing my tooth.
examples.cn: 牙医补完牙后给了我一张贴纸。

examples.en: Our class learned dental care from a visiting dentist.
examples.cn: 我们班听来访的牙医讲了牙齿护理知识。

definition_en: to need someone or something for support or success
core_image: 垂下的枝条紧抓着支架才不倒下
scene: 运动会上，接力赛成绩和队友配合有关。Our relay team will depend on every runner doing their best.
sceneCN: 这里 depend 是「取决于」（第 2 个义项：结果由某事决定）；句意是我们接力队能否取胜取决于每个人尽全力。

derivatives.zh: 由 depend 加名词后缀 -ence 构成，义为「依赖；依靠」
由 depend 加形容词后缀 -ent 构成，义为「依赖的；取决于…的」
由 in-（不）加 dependent 构成，义为「独立的」
由 sus-（下）加 pend（悬挂）构成，义为「悬挂；暂停」

senses.title: To need someone or something
senses.definition: to need the help or support of someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 需要某人或某物的帮助与支持
senses.example: The little cat still depends on its mother for food.
senses.exampleCN: 小猫还得靠猫妈妈喂食。
senses.why: To hang from something is to be held up by it, so needing support keeps the hanging image.
senses.whyCN: 「挂」在东西上就是被它撑着，需要支撑便保留了悬挂的画面。

senses.title: To be decided by something
senses.definition: to be controlled or decided by something else
senses.definitionCN: 由别的事物决定或控制
senses.example: Whether we have the match depends on the weather.
senses.exampleCN: 比赛是否举行取决于天气。
senses.why: A hanging thing moves with what holds it, so outcomes hang on their causes.
senses.whyCN: 悬挂之物随支点而动，结果便「挂」在原因上，随原因而定。

senses.title: To trust someone
senses.definition: to trust that someone will do what is needed
senses.definitionCN: 相信某人会做到所需之事
senses.example: You can depend on Li Ming to bring the ball.
senses.exampleCN: 你可以相信李明会把球带来。
senses.why: Trusting is leaning on a person, resting your weight on their promise.
senses.whyCN: 信任就是把自己「靠」在一个人身上，把重量放在他的承诺上。

intro.en: Depend comes from Latin words for hanging down.
intro.cn: depend 来自拉丁语中表示「垂下、悬挂」的词。

items.en: Dependere meant to hang down or hang from, from de- plus pendere (to hang).
items.cn: 拉丁语 dependere 意为垂下、挂于，由 de- 加 pendere（悬挂）构成。

items.en: French kept dependre for hanging things.
items.cn: 法语保留 dependre 表示悬挂。

items.en: English took depend in the fifteenth century, first for physical hanging.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪吸收 depend，最初指实际的悬挂。

items.en: The meaning moved to needing support, then to being decided by something.
items.cn: 词义转到「需要支撑」，再转到「由某事决定」。

items.en: It depends became a common answer meaning the case decides.
items.cn: It depends 成了常用回答，意为「看情况而定」。

note.en: These words share the hanging root or describe reliance.
note.cn: 这些词与「悬挂」词根同源，或同样描述依靠关系。

normal.cn: de-（向下）加 pend（悬挂）：挂在下面。

normal.cn: independent 以 in- 开头，表示不依赖。

abstract.en: Picture a swing hanging from a strong branch.
abstract.cn: 想象秋千挂在结实的树枝上。

abstract.en: Feel a baby bird waiting for its parent.
abstract.cn: 体会雏鸟等待亲鸟喂食的心情。

abstract.en: Hear a coach say the result depends on your training.
abstract.cn: 听教练说结果取决于你的训练。

examples.en: Young children depend on adults for food and safety.
examples.cn: 幼儿在饮食和安全上都依靠大人。

examples.en: The picnic depends on tomorrow's weather.
examples.cn: 野餐能不能成要看明天的天气。

examples.en: In team games, you depend on your teammates too.
examples.cn: 在团队比赛中，你也要依靠队友。

sensesIntro.en: Depend hangs from support, then leans into trust and condition.

definition_en: to say what something or someone is like in words
core_image: 用文字画出一幅画给别人看
scene: 作文课上老师让我们写公园的春天。Can you describe the cherry tree in your own words?
sceneCN: 这里 describe 是「描写」（第 1 个义项：用语言呈现样貌）；句意是你能用自己的话描写那棵樱花树吗？

derivatives.zh: 由 describe 变词尾加 -tion 构成，义为「描述；说明书」
由 describe 词根加 -ive 构成，义为「描写的；描述性的」
由 in-（写入）加 scribe（写）构成，义为「刻写；题写」

senses.title: To say what something is like
senses.definition: to give a picture of something in spoken or written words
senses.definitionCN: 用口语或文字呈现事物的样子
senses.example: She described the beach with bright, sunny words.
senses.exampleCN: 她用明亮 sunny 的词句描写那片海滩。
senses.why: Words can paint, so telling what you saw is drawing with the tongue.
senses.whyCN: 文字可以作画，讲述所见就像用舌头画画，这便是描写的本义。

senses.title: To call something a certain way
senses.definition: to say that something has a particular quality
senses.definitionCN: 说某事物具有某种性质
senses.example: Fans described the match as the best of the year.
senses.exampleCN: 球迷们把这场比赛形容为年度最佳。
senses.why: A short label is a fast sketch of the whole thing.
senses.whyCN: 一个简短的形容词是对事物整体的速写，于是有了形容义。

senses.title: To draw a shape in geometry
senses.definition: to draw or trace a shape so that it moves along a line
senses.definitionCN: 沿某条线画出或描出图形
senses.example: The compass describes a perfect circle on the board.
senses.exampleCN: 圆规在黑板上画出标准的圆。
senses.why: Tracing a line is writing in space, the same old root of marking down.
senses.whyCN: 在空间里描线就是一种「写画」，与记下的本义一脉相承。

intro.en: Describe comes from Latin words for writing down.
intro.cn: describe 来自拉丁语中表示「写下、描画」的词。

items.en: Describere meant to copy down or sketch, from de- plus scribere (to write).
items.cn: 拉丁语 describere 意为摹写、描画，由 de- 加 scribere（写）构成。

items.en: Scribere also gave script, scribe and scribble.
items.cn: scribere 还派生了 script、scribe、scribble 等词。

items.en: Old French carried descriivre into learned Latin-based writing.
items.cn: 古法语把 descriivre 带入书面语。

items.en: English took describe in the fifteenth century, first meaning to trace a figure.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪吸收 describe，最初意为描出图形。

items.en: The word settled as telling what things are like in words.
items.cn: 现代英语中它定型为用语言呈现事物的样貌。

note.en: These words share the writing root or describe telling about things.
note.cn: 这些词与「书写」词根同源，或同样描述讲述事物。

abstract.cn: 听电台解说员一幕一幕描述比赛。

abstract.en: Feel a friend's face light up as your words paint the place.
abstract.cn: 体会你的话语把景色画出来时朋友眼睛发亮的样子。

examples.en: Please describe your best friend so we can guess who it is.
examples.cn: 请描述你最好的朋友，让我们猜猜是谁。

examples.en: The guide described every corner of the old town.
examples.cn: 导游描述了老城的每个角落。

examples.en: It is hard to describe how exciting the sports day was.
examples.cn: 很难形容运动会那天有多激动人心。

definition_en: a large dry area of land with few plants because there is little rain
core_image: 一眼望不到边的金色沙丘
scene: 地理课上我们看了骆驼穿越沙丘的照片。A camel can walk for days across the hot desert with little water.
sceneCN: 这里 desert 是「沙漠」（第 1 个义项：少雨干旱之地）；句意是骆驼能在炎热的沙漠里几乎没有水地走上好几天。

derivatives.zh: 由 desert 加形容词后缀 -ed 构成，义为「无人的；被遗弃的」
由 desert 加 -fication 构成，义为「沙漠化」
拼写相近的另一个词，义为「甜点」

senses.title: A large dry land
senses.definition: a large area of land with very little rain and few plants
senses.definitionCN: 降雨极少、植物稀少的大片土地
senses.example: The desert is cold at night even in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 即使在夏天，沙漠的夜晚也很冷。
senses.why: Land abandoned by rain is left dry and empty, so it was called a deserted place.
senses.whyCN: 被雨水「抛弃」的土地变得干燥空旷，人们便称它为被遗弃之地，即沙漠。

senses.title: An empty, lonely place
senses.definition: any place that seems empty and without life
senses.definitionCN: 任何显得空旷而没有生气的地方
senses.example: At noon the playground was a desert of silence.
senses.exampleCN: 中午的操场是一片寂静的空旷。
senses.why: Emptiness borrows the desert picture wherever life is missing.
senses.whyCN: 凡是缺少生气的地方都借来沙漠的画面，于是有了荒凉空旷的比喻义。

intro.en: Desert comes from Latin words for leaving and abandoning.
intro.cn: desert 来自拉丁语中表示「离开、抛弃」的词。

items.en: De- means away, and serere means to join or plant; desertus meant abandoned.
items.cn: 拉丁语 de- 表示离开，serere 意为结合、种植；desertus 意为被抛弃的。

items.en: Desertum named land forsaken by people or by rain.
items.cn: desertum 指被人或雨水抛弃的土地。

items.en: Old French desert meant emptiness and abandonment.
items.cn: 古法语 desert 意为空旷、遗弃。

items.en: English took the word in the thirteenth century for wild empty land.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪吸收该词，指荒芜空旷之地。

items.en: It narrowed to the hot sandy kind of empty land we call desert today.
items.cn: 现代英语中它缩小为今天所说的炎热多沙的沙漠。

note.en: These words share the leaving root or describe dry empty land.
note.cn: 这些词与「离开」词根同源，或同样描述干旱空旷的土地。

examples.en: Some deserts get less rain in a year than we get in one afternoon.
examples.cn: 有些沙漠一年的降水还不如我们一个下午的雨多。

examples.en: The story is about a boy who crossed a desert to find water for his village.
examples.cn: 这个故事讲一个男孩穿越沙漠为村子找水。

examples.en: After the fair left, the field looked like a desert of torn paper.
examples.cn: 集市散场后，场地像一片纸屑的荒漠。

sensesIntro.en: Desert begins as abandoned land and stretches to any empty place.
sensesIntro.cn: desert 先指被遗弃的土地，再延伸到一切空旷之地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: land left behind by rain
core.cn: 核心意象：被雨水遗弃的土地

intro.en: Desert is built on the Latin root for leaving.
intro.cn: desert 建立在拉丁语「离开」词根上。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root ser or sert means to join, to plant.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 ser/sert 意为结合、种植。

camp in the wilderness（在荒野露营）

definition_zh: 书桌；办公桌；课桌；服务台
definition_en: a table where you write, read or work
core_image: 亮着台灯、摊着作业本的那张桌子
scene: 晚自习后，我的书桌上摆着字典和笔记本。My desk lamp helps me read before bed.
sceneCN: 这里 desk 是「书桌」（第 1 个义项：读书写字用的桌子）；句意是睡前我的台灯帮我照明读书。

derivatives.zh: 由 desk 加 top 构成，义为「桌面；台式电脑」
由 desk 加 bound 构成，义为「伏案工作的；久坐桌前的」

senses.title: A table for writing and study
senses.definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top used for writing, reading or study
senses.definitionCN: 有平整台面、用于书写阅读的家具
senses.example: There is a pencil box and three books on my desk.
senses.exampleCN: 我的书桌上有铅笔盒和三本书。
senses.why: Study needs a steady surface, and the word named the working table itself.
senses.whyCN: 学习需要平稳的台面，这个词便指代那张工作用的桌子。

senses.title: A work table in an office
senses.definition: a table in an office where a person works
senses.definitionCN: 办公室里供人工作的桌子
senses.example: Dad's office desk is always full of papers.
senses.exampleCN: 爸爸的办公桌上总是堆满文件。
senses.why: The same working surface follows you from school to work.
senses.whyCN: 同一张「干活用的台面」从学校跟随到职场，便有了办公桌义。

senses.title: A counter for service
senses.definition: a place where people ask questions or get help in a hotel or public building
senses.definitionCN: 旅馆或公共建筑里咨询或求助的地方
senses.example: Ask at the front desk for the Wi-Fi password.
senses.exampleCN: 到前台问 Wi-Fi 密码。
senses.why: A person works behind a desk, so the desk names the service point.
senses.whyCN: 工作人员坐在桌后服务，桌子便代指服务台，这是借物代位的说法。

intro.en: Desk came from Latin through Italian and French, naming a working table.
intro.cn: desk 经拉丁语、意大利语和法语传入英语，指工作用的桌子。

items.en: Desca meant a table to work on.
items.cn: 拉丁语 desca 意为工作用的桌子。

items.en: Italian desco kept the meaning of a serving or writing table.
items.cn: 意大利语 desco 保留餐台、书桌的含义。

items.en: Old French desque carried the word north.
items.cn: 古法语 desque 把这个词传向北方。

items.en: English took desk in the fourteenth century for a reading table.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪吸收 desk，指读书用的桌子。

items.en: Offices, hotels and computers added new kinds of desks.
items.cn: 办公室、旅馆与电脑的发展让 desk 有了新的种类。

note.en: These words name furniture and work places around a desk.
note.cn: 这些词指称书桌周围的家具与场所。

entries.definition: the screen surface or a big computer
a small lamp for a desk
the box under a desk top
a round flat thing, different root
entries.definitionCN: 圆盘（拼写相近，词源无关）

entries.definition: what you sit on at a desk
a room with a desk for work

normalIntro.en: Use the study corner image to remember desk.
normalIntro.cn: 用「学习角落」的画面记住 desk。

normal.en: desk and disc end the same but differ totally.
normal.cn: desk 与 disc 结尾相同，意思完全不同。

normal.en: sit at your desk to do homework.
normal.cn: sit at your desk 表示坐在书桌前。

normal.en: front desk is where you ask for help.
normal.cn: front desk 是求助的前台。

normal.en: desktop is the computer on a desk.
normal.cn: desktop 是放在桌上的台式电脑。

normal.en: keep your desk tidy, keep your mind tidy.
normal.cn: 书桌整洁，思路也整洁。

abstract.en: Picture lamplight pooling on an open exercise book.
abstract.cn: 想象灯光洒在摊开的练习本上。

abstract.en: Hear a pen tapping while you think.
abstract.cn: 听思考时笔尖轻敲桌面的声音。

abstract.en: Feel the smooth cool edge under your wrist.
abstract.cn: 体会手腕下光滑微凉的桌沿。

examples.en: Our new classroom desks can be moved for group work.
examples.cn: 我们教室的新课桌可以移动，方便小组活动。

examples.en: Please hand in your form at the information desk.
examples.cn: 请把表格交到问询处。

examples.en: My desk drawer holds my stamps and my stickers.
examples.cn: 我的书桌抽屉里放着邮票和贴纸。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「德斯克」——desk 读音像「的斯克」，书桌上「的刻度」提醒你写字

root: 经意大利语 desco、古法语 desque 来自拉丁语 desca（工作台）；原指读书写字的桌子，后扩展到办公桌与服务台。

sensesIntro.en: Desk starts as your study table and grows into offices and service counters.
sensesIntro.cn: desk 从学习用桌，扩展到办公桌与服务台。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady surface for work
core.cn: 核心意象：一张平稳的工作台面

branches.cn: 同一张台面，不同的工作

intro.en: Desk is a simple word that builds compound tools.
intro.cn: desk 是个简单词，能组成许多复合词。

latinIntro.en: Desk came through Latin desca, a working table.
latinIntro.cn: desk 经拉丁语 desca（工作台）而来。

items.exampleCN: turn on the desk lamp（打开台灯）
front desk check-in（前台入住办理）
ask at the information desk（问询处询问）
sign in at reception（在接待处登记）
work in the study（在书房工作）

definition_en: to grow or change into a bigger, better or more complete form
core_image: 种子一天天长成小树的过程
scene: 学校的菜园里，我们种下番茄种子。The little plants develop slowly in the warm spring sun.
sceneCN: 这里 develop 是「生长、成长」（第 1 个义项：逐渐长大变化）；句意是幼苗在温暖的春日下慢慢生长。

derivatives.zh: 由 develop 加名词后缀 -ment 构成，义为「发展；开发」
由 develop 的现在分词转成形容词，义为「发展中的」
由 develop 加 -er 构成，义为「开发者；开发商」

senses.title: To grow into a fuller form
senses.definition: to grow or change gradually into a bigger or better state
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐长大或变为更好更完整的状态
senses.example: Her confidence developed after many school concerts.
senses.exampleCN: 经过多场校园演出，她的自信逐渐建立起来。
senses.why: Growth happens step by step, unseen between one day and the next.
senses.whyCN: 成长是一步步发生的，一天与一天之间悄然变化，这便是发展的本义。

senses.title: To create something new
senses.definition: to design and make something new or improve it
senses.definitionCN: 设计制造新事物或加以改进
senses.example: Scientists develop new ways to clean river water.
senses.exampleCN: 科学家开发净化河水的新方法。
senses.why: An idea also grows from a seed into a finished thing, so creation borrowed the growth word.
senses.whyCN: 想法也从种子长成成品，创造便借用了生长的词。

senses.title: To begin to have something
senses.definition: to start to have a habit, an interest or an illness
senses.definitionCN: 开始形成习惯、兴趣或出现疾病
senses.example: He developed a cough after the cold rainy trip.
senses.exampleCN: 那次寒冷多雨的行程之后他开始咳嗽。
senses.why: Habits and illnesses also grow quietly inside a person.
senses.whyCN: 习惯与疾病也在人身上悄然生长，所以「开始有」也用这个词。

intro.en: Develop comes from French words for unfolding.
intro.cn: develop 来自法语中表示「展开」的词。

items.en: Dis- plus volvere meant to unroll, to unwrap.
items.cn: 拉丁语 dis- 加 volvere 意为展开、解开。

items.en: French developed deweloper, to unwrap or unfold.
items.cn: 法语形成了 deweloper，意为展开、揭示。

items.en: English took develop in the seventeenth century, first for unfolding plans or images.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪吸收 develop，最初指展开计划或显影图像。

items.en: Photography used it for making pictures appear on film.
items.cn: 摄影术用它指使影像在底片上显现。

items.en: Industry and science widened it to growing ideas, skills and countries.
items.cn: 工业与科学把它扩展到想法、技能与国家的发展。

note.en: These words share the rolling root or describe growth.
note.cn: 这些词与「滚动」词根同源，或同样描述生长。

entries.definition: the act of growing or a new building area

normalIntro.en: Use the unfolding image and the volv family to remember develop.
normalIntro.cn: 用「展开」的画面和 volv 词族记住 develop。

normal.en: de- plus velop: unfold what is wrapped.
normal.cn: de- 加 velop：把包着的东西展开。

normal.en: envelope and develop come from the same root.
normal.cn: envelope 与 develop 同词源。

normal.en: development is the noun form.
normal.cn: development 是名词形式。

normal.en: develop a habit means form a habit slowly.
normal.cn: develop a habit 表示慢慢养成习惯。

normal.en: the second e is light: de-VEL-op.
normal.cn: 第二个 e 读轻音：de-VEL-op。

abstract.en: Picture a paper flower unfolding in water.
abstract.cn: 想象纸花在水中慢慢绽放。

abstract.en: Feel a skill growing steadier week by week.
abstract.cn: 体会一项技能一周周变得熟练。

abstract.en: Hear a city getting busier year after year.
abstract.cn: 听城市一年年变得更有活力。

examples.en: Reading every night helps you develop a rich vocabulary.
examples.cn: 每晚阅读能帮你积累丰富的词汇。

examples.en: Our city has developed new bike lanes for students.
examples.cn: 我们城市为学生们修建了新的自行车道。

examples.en: He developed an interest in stars after the science trip.
examples.cn: 科学参观之后，他对星星产生了兴趣。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「地外勒扑」——地外星球也要发展，得勒紧劲头扑上去

root: 经法语 deweloper 来自拉丁语 dis- 加 volvere（展开、滚动）；本义「展开包裹之物」，引申为「发展、成长」。

sensesIntro.en: Develop unfolds a package, then grows ideas, skills and cities.
sensesIntro.cn: develop 先展开包裹，再生长出想法、技能与城市。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something unfolding step by step
core.cn: 核心意象：一步步展开的过程

branches.en: Seeds in soil and in mind

intro.en: Develop is built on the Latin root for rolling and unfolding.
intro.cn: develop 建立在拉丁语「滚动、展开」词根上。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root volv or volut means to roll and turn.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 volv/volut 意为滚动、转动。

items.exampleCN: cultivate reading habits（培养阅读习惯）

definition_en: the process of growing or changing into a better or bigger form; a new event
core_image: 从草图到大楼一点点长高的工地
scene: 校门口那块空地围了起来，公告牌写着新图书馆工程。The development of the new library will finish next autumn.
sceneCN: 这里 development 是「开发、建设」（第 2 个义项：具体的开发项目）；句意是新图书馆的建设将于明年秋天完工。

collocations.zh: 一个新进展；新建开发区

derivatives.zh: development 的动词形式，义为「发展；开发」
由 develop 加 -ing 构成，义为「发展中的」
由 develop 加 -er 构成，义为「开发者；开发商」

senses.title: The process of growing or improving
senses.definition: the process of becoming bigger, better or more complete
senses.definitionCN: 变得更大、更好或更完整的过程
senses.example: The development of her drawing skill took three years.
senses.exampleCN: 她绘画技能的成长花了三年。
senses.why: Unfolding takes time, and the finished process needs its own name.
senses.whyCN: 展开需要时间，这个完整的过程需要专属的名字，便是 development。

senses.title: A new building or project
senses.definition: a group of new buildings or an area being built
senses.definitionCN: 新建的楼群或正在建设的区域
senses.example: A quiet housing development stands where the farm used to be.
senses.exampleCN: 农场原址上矗立着一片安静的住宅新区。
senses.why: What developers build was named after the act of developing.
senses.whyCN: 开发商开发出来的成果便以「开发」这一行为命名。

senses.title: A new event or change
senses.definition: a new event that changes a situation
senses.definitionCN: 改变局面的事件或变化
senses.example: The early goal was an unexpected development in the match.
senses.exampleCN: 开场进球是比赛中出乎意料的新变化。
senses.why: A situation also unfolds, and each new turn is one development.
senses.whyCN: 局势也在不断展开，每一次新的转折就是一个 development。

intro.en: Development is the noun of develop, keeping the unfolding idea.
intro.cn: development 是 develop 的名词，保留了「展开」的意思。

items.en: Volvere meant to roll; dis- added the sense of unrolling.
items.cn: 拉丁语 volvere 意为滚动；dis- 增加展开之意。

items.en: French developpement carried the word into formal writing.
items.cn: 法语 developpement 把这个词带入正式书面语。

items.en: English formed development with the noun ending -ment.
items.cn: 英语用名词后缀 -ment 构成 development。

items.en: Science and industry used it for growth processes of all kinds.
items.cn: 科学与工业用它指各种生长过程。

items.en: City building gave it the sense of a new housing or business project.
items.cn: 城市建设赋予它住宅或商业开发项目的含义。

note.en: These words share the develop family or describe growth and change.
note.cn: 这些词属于 develop 词族，或同样描述生长与变化。

entries.definitionCN: 环境（拼写相近，词源无关）

entries.definition: tools for a task, different root
entries.definitionCN: 设备（拼写相近，词源无关）

normalIntro.en: Use the -ment ending and the unfold image to remember development.
normalIntro.cn: 用 -ment 后缀和「展开」的画面记住 development。

normal.en: develop plus -ment makes the noun.
normal.cn: develop 加 -ment 构成名词。

normal.en: child development is studied by doctors and teachers.
normal.cn: 医生和教师都研究 child development（儿童发育）。

normal.en: recent developments means the latest news.
normal.cn: recent developments 指最新动态。

normal.en: -ment words: movement, agreement, development.
normal.cn: -ment 词例：movement、agreement、development。

normal.en: a housing development is a group of new homes.
normal.cn: a housing development 指新建住宅区。

abstract.en: Picture scaffolds climbing floor by floor.
abstract.cn: 想象脚手架一层层升高。

abstract.en: Feel your own growth measured in school years.
abstract.cn: 体会用学年丈量自己的成长。

abstract.en: Hear news readers say breaking developments.
abstract.cn: 听新闻播报员说 breaking developments（最新进展）。

examples.en: The teacher praised the steady development of my handwriting.
examples.cn: 老师称赞我书写能力的稳步进步。

examples.en: Every match brings new developments, so plans must change.
examples.cn: 每场比赛都有新变化，所以计划也要调整。

examples.en: The park's development includes a small library for children.
examples.cn: 公园的规划中包含一座儿童小图书馆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「地外勒扑门」——地外探索推进新进展，勒劲扑向大门

root: 来自 develop 加名词后缀 -ment，词根 volv（滚动、展开）经法语传入；「展开的过程」即发展，再引申为开发项目与最新动态。

sensesIntro.en: Development names the unfolding process, the built result and the newest turn.
sensesIntro.cn: development 指展开的过程、建成的成果与最新的转折。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the long arc of unfolding
core.cn: 核心意象：展开过程的完整弧线

intro.en: Development keeps the develop root and adds a noun ending.
intro.cn: development 保留 develop 词根并加名词后缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root volv means to roll and turn.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 volv 意为滚动、转动。

items.exampleCN: the development of the area（该地区的开发）
involve all students（让所有学生参与）
the growth of a city（城市的发展）

definition_en: a talk between two or more people; the words spoken by characters in a story or play
core_image: 两张嘴一来一回的言语抛接
scene: 英语课上，同桌和我分角色朗读课文。We read the dialogue between the shopkeeper and the customer.
sceneCN: 这里 dialogue 是「对话」（第 1 个义项：两人之间的言语交流）；句意是我们朗读店主与顾客之间的对话。

derivatives.zh: 由 dialogue 词根加 -ic 构成，义为「对话的」
由 mono-（独）加 -logue 构成，义为「独白」
同词源家族词，义为「道歉；辩护」

senses.title: A talk between people
senses.definition: a conversation between two or more people
senses.definitionCN: 两个或多人之间的交谈
senses.example: The teacher encouraged a dialogue between the two classes.
senses.exampleCN: 老师鼓励两个班级之间开展对话。
senses.why: Two voices cross a bridge of words, throwing meaning back and forth.
senses.whyCN: 两个声音用词语搭起桥梁，把意义抛来抛去，这便是对话。

senses.title: Words spoken by characters
senses.definition: the words that characters say in a play, film or story
senses.definitionCN: 戏剧、电影或故事中人物说的话
senses.example: The movie's dialogue is quick and funny.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影的对白节奏快而有趣。
senses.why: Written talk freezes a real conversation onto the page.
senses.whyCN: 书面的言语把真实的交谈固定在纸面上，于是有了对白义。

senses.title: An exchange of ideas
senses.definition: a serious exchange of ideas between groups or countries
senses.definitionCN: 团体或国家之间认真的思想交流
senses.example: Peace starts with honest dialogue, not shouting.
senses.exampleCN: 和平始于坦诚的对话，而非喊叫。
senses.why: Real understanding needs both sides speaking and listening in turn.
senses.whyCN: 真正的理解需要双方轮流说与听，交流义由此生长。

intro.en: Dialogue comes from Greek words for speaking through or across.
intro.cn: dialogue 来自希腊语中表示「穿越着说话」的词。

items.en: Dialogos meant conversation, from dia- (across) plus logos (word, speech).
items.cn: 希腊语 dialogos 意为谈话，由 dia-（穿越）加 logos（词、言语）构成。

items.en: Plato wrote his philosophy as dialogues between teacher and students.
items.cn: 柏拉图以师生对话的形式写哲学，即《对话录》。

items.en: Latin dialogus and French dialogue carried it westward.
items.cn: 拉丁语 dialogus 与法语 dialogue 把它传向西方。

items.en: English took dialogue in the fourteenth century for written conversations.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪吸收 dialogue，指书面对话。

items.en: It now names talks in plays, films, classrooms and world politics.
items.cn: 如今它指戏剧、电影、课堂乃至国际交往中的对话。

note.en: These words share the speaking root or describe kinds of talk.
note.cn: 这些词与「言语」词根同源，或同样描述说话方式。

entries.definition: a long speech by one person

normalIntro.en: Use the two-voices image and the -logue family to remember dialogue.
normalIntro.cn: 用「两个声音」的画面和 -logue 词族记住 dialogue。

normal.en: dia- (across) plus logue (word): words going across.
normal.cn: dia-（穿越）加 logue（词）：词语穿越而过。

normal.en: monologue is one voice, dialogue is two.
normal.cn: monologue 是独语，dialogue 是对话。

normal.en: read a dialogue aloud with a partner.
normal.cn: 和同伴朗读 dialogue。

normal.en: movie dialogue is what actors say.
normal.cn: movie dialogue 指演员的对白。

normal.en: the gue ending keeps the French spelling.
normal.cn: 词尾 gue 保留了法语拼法。

abstract.en: Picture a tennis ball of words flying both ways.
abstract.cn: 想象词语的网球双向飞舞。

abstract.en: Hear two characters answering each other in turn.
abstract.cn: 听剧中人物一问一答。

abstract.en: Feel two ideas meeting and growing together.

senses.title: A book of words and meanings

senses.example: The dictionary shows the word's spelling, sound and meaning.
senses.exampleCN: 词典列出单词的拼写、发音和含义。
senses.why: It is a storehouse of words said, written down for anyone who asks.

senses.title: A trusted reference work

definition_en: to stop living; to stop existing or working
core_image: 灯火摇曳几下后归于平静
scene: 爷爷在院子里讲他年轻时的故事，说到老屋的旧灯。The old lantern finally died after many years of service.
sceneCN: 这里 die 是「熄灭、失效」（第 2 个义项：停止运作）；句意是服役多年的旧灯笼终于熄灭了。

derivatives.zh: die 的名词形式，义为「死亡」
die 词族的形容词，义为「死的」
die 的现在分词转形容词，义为「垂死的」
由 dead 加 -ly 构成，义为「致命的」

senses.title: To stop living
senses.definition: to stop being alive
senses.definitionCN: 停止生存
senses.example: The old cat died quietly in its sleep last winter.
senses.exampleCN: 去年冬天，老猫在睡梦中安静地离世。
senses.why: Life leaves a body the way a flame leaves a wick.
senses.whyCN: 生命离开躯体，如同火苗离开灯芯，归于平静。

senses.title: To stop working or existing
senses.definition: to stop working, burning or existing gradually
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐停止运作、燃烧或存在
senses.example: The engine died in the middle of the road.
senses.exampleCN: 发动机在路中间熄火了。
senses.why: Machines and fires lose their life too, so they are said to die.
senses.whyCN: 机器与火焰也有「生命」，失去动力便被说成 die。

senses.title: To want something very much
senses.definition: to want something so much that you feel desperate, informal
senses.definitionCN: 口语中表示极度渴望
senses.example: After the long run, I was dying for a glass of water.
senses.exampleCN: 长跑之后，我特别想喝一杯水。
senses.why: Strong want feels like a small death of patience.
senses.whyCN: 强烈的渴望让耐心几乎「死去」，口语便用 die 夸张表达。

intro.en: Die came from Norse words for passing away.
intro.cn: die 来自古诺尔斯语中表示「逝去」的词。

items.en: The Norse word deyja meant to pass away.
items.cn: 古诺尔斯语 deyja 意为死去。

items.en: English took deyen around the thirteenth century.
items.cn: 约十三世纪英语吸收 deyen。

items.en: Old English had its own words like steorfan, which became starve.
items.cn: 古英语原有 steorfan 一词，后来变成 starve（饿死）。

items.en: Die became the plain everyday verb for stopping to live.
items.cn: die 成为表示死亡最平实常用的动词。

items.en: Spelling settled at four letters, kept distinct from dye.
items.cn: 拼写定为四字母，与 dye（染色）区分。

note.en: These words belong to the die family or describe endings.
note.cn: 这些词属于 die 词族，或同样描述终结。

entries.definition: to die, especially in a disaster

normalIntro.en: Use the flame image and the die family to remember the word.
normalIntro.cn: 用「火苗」的画面和 die 词族记住这个词。

normal.en: die is the verb; dead is the adjective; death is the noun.
normal.cn: die 是动词，dead 是形容词，death 是名词。

normal.en: dying keeps the e before -ing.
normal.cn: 现在分词 dying 保留 e 再加 -ing。

normal.en: dye with an e means colour cloth.
normal.cn: 带 e 的 dye 表示染色。

normal.en: die out means disappear completely.
normal.cn: die out 表示彻底消失。

normal.en: be dying for is informal and strong.
normal.cn: be dying for 是口语中表示强烈渴望的用法。

abstract.en: Picture a candle's flame bending and then standing still.
abstract.cn: 想象烛火弯了弯便静止下来。

abstract.en: Hear an engine slow, cough and stop.
abstract.cn: 听发动机放慢、咳嗽一声后停转。

abstract.en: Feel the dry throat that longs for cold water.
abstract.cn: 体会渴望凉水的干涩喉咙。

examples.en: The fish died because the water was too warm.
examples.cn: 因为水太热，鱼死了。

examples.en: The phone battery died during the school trip.
examples.cn: 学校出游途中手机电池耗尽熄机了。

examples.en: Many old songs never die; new students still sing them.
examples.cn: 许多老歌永不消逝，新学生仍在传唱。

root: 来自古诺尔斯语 deyja（死去），十三世纪进入英语，取代古英语 steorfan；同族名词 death、形容词 dead。

definition_en: the way in which people or things are not the same
core_image: 并排的两样东西之间那道看不见的缝
scene: 科学课上我们比较了两个杯子的水温。There is a small difference in temperature between the two cups.
sceneCN: 这里 difference 是「差异」（第 1 个义项：不一样的程度）；句意是两个杯子之间的水温略有差异。

derivatives.zh: difference 的形容词形式，义为「不同的」
由拉丁词根 differ 派生的动词，义为「不同；相异」
由 different 加 -ly 构成，义为「不同地」

senses.title: The way things are not the same
senses.definition: the quality or amount of being unlike
senses.definitionCN: 不一样的地方或程度
senses.example: The difference between the twins is easy to see now.
senses.exampleCN: 如今这对双胞胎的差异一眼就能看出。
senses.why: When two things stand apart, the gap between them gets a name.
senses.whyCN: 两样东西分开站着，它们之间的缝隙需要名字，这便是差异。

senses.title: The amount left after subtracting
senses.definition: the number that remains when one number is taken from another
senses.definitionCN: 一个数减去另一个数所得的结果
senses.example: The difference between nine and four is five.
senses.exampleCN: 九减四的差是五。
senses.why: Numbers also stand apart, and the distance between them is the gap.
senses.whyCN: 数字之间也有距离，两者相减留下的便是「差」。

senses.title: A disagreement
senses.definition: a disagreement between people
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间的意见不合
senses.example: Good friends can settle their differences with a talk.
senses.exampleCN: 好朋友能通过谈话化解分歧。
senses.why: Minds that stand apart create a gap of opinion.
senses.whyCN: 意见相左如同两颗心站开了距离，分歧便是想法间的缝。

intro.en: Difference comes from Latin words for carrying apart.
intro.cn: difference 来自拉丁语中表示「分开携带」的词。

items.en: Differre meant to carry apart, from dis- plus ferre (to carry).
items.cn: 拉丁语 differre 意为分开携带，由 dis- 加 ferre（搬运）构成。

items.en: Differentia named the quality of being unlike.
items.cn: differentia 指不相同这一性质。

items.en: Old French difference carried it into learned writing.
items.cn: 古法语 difference 把它带入书面语。

items.en: English took difference in the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪吸收 difference。

items.en: Maths fixed the subtraction sense, and daily speech added the disagreement sense.
items.cn: 数学固定了差数义，日常用语增添了分歧义。

note.en: These words share the carrying-apart root or describe gaps.
note.cn: 这些词与「分开携带」词根同源，或同样描述差距。

normalIntro.cn: 用「缝隙」的画面和 ferre 词族记住 difference。

normal.en: the difference between two things is the gap.
normal.cn: the difference between 表示两者间的差距。

normal.en: make a difference means change something.
normal.cn: make a difference 表示带来改变。

normal.en: in maths, difference is the answer to subtraction.

normal.en: different is the adjective; difference is the noun.

abstract.en: Picture two lines drawn slightly apart.
abstract.cn: 想象两条微微分开的线。

abstract.en: Feel the small click when you finally spot the change.
abstract.cn: 体会终于发现变化时的轻轻一悟。

abstract.en: Hear friends laughing about their small disagreements.
abstract.cn: 听朋友们笑着聊彼此的小分歧。

examples.en: What is the difference between a rabbit and a hare?
examples.cn: 家兔和野兔有什么区别？

examples.en: One kind word can make a big difference to a sad friend.
examples.cn: 一句暖心的话能让难过的朋友大为改观。

examples.en: Our team won by a difference of two points.
examples.cn: 我们队以两分之差获胜。

definition_en: not the same as another or each other
core_image: 一排颜色各异的杯子
scene: 美术课上，每人挑了一支画笔。We all drew the same tree, but the pictures came out different.
sceneCN: 这里 different 是「不同的」（第 1 个义项：彼此不一样）；句意是大家画同一棵树，作品却各不相同。

senses.title: Not the same as another
senses.definition: unlike something or someone else
senses.definitionCN: 与其他事物或人不一样
senses.example: This year's school trip is different from last year's.
senses.exampleCN: 今年的学校郊游和去年不一样。
senses.why: Two things carried apart leave a visible gap between them.
senses.whyCN: 两样东西被分开携带，之间便留下看得见的缝隙，这便是「不同」。

senses.title: Several separate ones
senses.definition: used before a plural noun to mean several unlike ones
senses.definitionCN: 修饰复数名词，表示若干个各不相同的事物
senses.example: We chose different books from the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 我们从书架上各自挑选了不同的书。
senses.why: Many things each carried their own way no longer overlap.
senses.whyCN: 许多东西各自朝不同方向被带走，彼此不再重合。

senses.title: Unusual or new
senses.definition: unusual or better than usual, informal
senses.definitionCN: 口语中表示不寻常或与众不同
senses.example: Her hand-painted bag looks really different.
senses.exampleCN: 她手绘的书包看起来真的很别致。
senses.why: Standing apart from the crowd is often a compliment.
senses.whyCN: 与众人拉开距离往往是种赞美，于是「不同」也带上了夸奖的意味。

examples.en: Each season brings different colours to the campus.
examples.cn: 每个季节都给校园带来不同的色彩。

examples.en: Trying different hobbies helps you find your real interest.
